interests.name: Elon Musk

interests.notes: New long-form interviews and podcast appearances first. Then real news on Tesla, SpaceX, Starship, xAI, Neuralink. Skip gossip.

interests.name: The Joe Rogan Experience
interests.notes: Newest full episodes. Flag standout guests.

interests.name: Drake
interests.value: Drake new song OR album OR release
interests.notes: Latest drops: singles, albums, features, videos. Release news only, not beef or gossip unless it comes with music.

interests.name: AI instructionals
interests.value: Claude Code OR AI agents tutorial OR how to build with AI
interests.notes: Hands-on tutorials and walkthroughs: Claude, Claude Code, agents, MCP, local models, AI coding workflows. Prefer videos to learn from over hype.

interests.name: Lex Fridman Podcast (YouTube)
interests.notes: Long-form interviews, especially tech, AI and Elon.

interests.name: AI news
interests.value: Anthropic OR OpenAI OR xAI Grok new model release
interests.notes: New model releases, real capability jumps, tools a builder could actually use. Skip funding rounds and opinion pieces.

interests.name: Interesting new tech
interests.value: new technology breakthrough OR new gadget launch
interests.notes: Robots, rockets, batteries, chips, EVs, clever hardware. Things an engineer would forward to a friend.

interests.name: Tesla owner news

interests.notes: FSD releases, software updates, service and hardware retrofit news for owners.

interests.name: LA Dodgers

interests.name: Fantasy football

interests.name: Guitar
